---
title: Prawn Tails and Fava Beans
id: MAR-0005
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 30
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 12 prawn tails
- 16 cherry tomatoes
- 300 g fava beans
- to taste lemon juice (from ½ lemons)
- 6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Blanch the fava beans for 5 minutes in salted water, drain them and peel them.
2. Put the fava beans in the blender, add the lemon juice, a few tablespoons of their cooking water and 4 tablespoons of oil; salt, pepper and blend.
3. Wash the cherry tomatoes and cut them into wedges.
4. Spread the fava bean cream evenly on the serving plate, distribute the cherry tomatoes and the prawn tails on top.
5. Season with the remaining oil and serve.
